name: agent-workflow-v2
description: An isolated beta of a portable, risk-proportionate coding-agent workflow with planning and review foundations.

interface.shortDescription: Test the portable Workflow V2 planning and review foundation.
interface.longDescription: Agent Workflow V2 is an isolated beta. Its current slices provide portable planning, authority, minimum-sufficient design, route selection, testing, and certifying review; the implementation entrypoint remains unavailable until its execution contract is ported.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Agent Workflow V2 planning beta to choose and prepare the lightest sufficient route for this work.
